evidence.quoted_text:
[MCP_SERVER_NAME]: installNativeToolCallAdapter(
                sdk.createSdkMcpServer({ name: MCP_SERVER_NAME, tools: sdkTools }),
                surface,
                (name, args, extra) =>
                  runHarnessTool(
                    surface,
                    name,
                    args,
                    store,
                    record,
                    observation.denials,
                    callSignal(signal, extra),
                  ),
evidence.reason: The dispatch registers the harness tool handler with direct access to observation.denials, but after the SDK query loop throws or breaks the code does not track or await in-flight tool handlers before building the verdict. A pending runHarnessTool can therefore append a denial or session mutation after run() returns, so the returned WorkerResult can miss or race the denial. This is an ordinary denial-accounting correctness defect, not a new requirement.
